text:
maria: Hey team — finalizing speakers + run-of-show for the "Live Benchmarks & Routing" webinar. Need quick confirmation on abstracts and who can do the live demo.
aj: I can do the live demo if we keep it to a focused 6–8 minute flow. prefer showing latency vs cost for 3 configs.
sam: +1 on the short demo. can we use prerecorded recording as fallback? last time streaming went shaky. :grimacing:
elaine: I can present the architecture/why routing matters (4 min). Will draft a 2-sentence abstract now.
maria: Perfect. aj — can you list the model variants you'll demo? we should match messaging to the abstract.
aj: Planning: rdm-7b-quant (fast, cheap), rdm-13b-std (balanced), rdm-34b-alt (quality). Will run 3 identical prompts and show latency, token cost, and output snippet.
sam: For fallback, I'll pre-record the demo and upload to the shared drive. If livestream fails, we play recording and we keep Q&A live.
maria: Abstract options — pick one: A) "How to pick the right inference configuration for cost & latency at scale." B) "Benchmarking strategies that protect UX while cutting token spend." C) "Routing and caching tactics to avoid spikes and save $$." Which feels closest to the demo?
elaine: B is my vote. It's audience-friendly and ties to the benchmark narrative.
aj: B works. short abstract: "We walk through benchmark-driven choices for model variants, routing, and caching so teams get predictable latency without exploding cost."
maria: Nice. I'll put that in the registration page. can we get speaker bios? 2 lines each.
sam: Bio draft: "Sam K — Solutions engineer, specializes in production inference tooling and demo ops. Helps customers balance cost/latency tradeoffs."
elaine: Bio draft: "Elaine W — Product lead for routing and orchestration. Focused on resilience and predictable user-facing latency."
aj: Bio draft: "AJ P — Runtime engineer, builds low-latency kernels and batching strategies used in production."
maria: Rehearsal times — options: Tue 10am PT (tight), Wed 2pm PT (preferred), Thu 5pm PT (late). Which works?
aj: Wed 2pm PT works.
sam: Wed works for me too.
elaine: Wed is good.
maria: Cool — scheduling Wed 2pm PT. I'll ping calendar with agenda.
rehearsal-bot: Reminder set: "Live Benchmarks rehearsal" Wed 2:00 PM PT. Invite: maria, aj, sam, elaine. (auto)
ops-bot: Heads up — please upload recorded fallback to /shared/marketing/webinars/bench-demo/fallback.mp4 before Tue 11:59 PM PT.
sam: Uploaded fallback at 2756790200 — link: https://drive.redwood.co/bench-demo/fallback.mp4
aj: For run-of-show, draft below — feedback pls:
```
0:00–0:30  Host intro + housekeeping
0:30–6:00  Product story + architecture (Elaine) + quick slides
6:00–14:00 Live demo (AJ) — three model configs, latency/cost charts
14:00–18:00 Sam plays recorded deep-dive if needed / live fallback switch
18:00–25:00 Panel Q&A (all)
25:00–27:00 CTA + registration follow-up
```
maria: Love it. Couple notes: shorten the demo intro to 30s (jump to demos faster). Also mark the slide where we show explicit routing policy YAML snippet so ops teams can copy.
aj: I'll add a short code snippet for routing policy. sample:
```
route:
  - priority: latency
    model: rdm-7b-quant
  - fallback: rdm-13b-std
    region: us-west
```
elaine: Can we also surface the telemetry dashboard during demo? need to show per-route latency & token breakdowns.
sam: Yup — I'll prepare a dashboard view and a short explanation of the cost delta numbers.
maria: Marketing asks: 1) 3-line abstract for the landing page (we have), 2) 30-word social blurb, 3) one tweetable stat to use in promo. Ideas?
aj: Tweetable stat idea: "Reduce per-token latency by up to 3x with routing + quantization in real workloads."
sam: Social blurb: "Join us to see real-world benchmarks that unlock better latency & lower token spend — live demos + rubric for your team."
maria: I'll draft creative and loop design for image. need high-contrast chart from the demo for hero.
elaine: Small ask — can we include a slide about enterprise fallbacks (dedicated -> hosted -> private) and when to choose each? 1 slide.
maria: Yes, add 1 slide. aj — can you prepare 1-slide decision matrix?
aj: On it. will share by Tue 6pm PT.
sam: One operational note: during rehearsals let's run the demo on a smaller prompt set to reduce flakiness. we'll do full run during production.
maria: Good call. last item: who will monitor registration chat + incoming questions during live?
elaine: I can triage live chat. sam can handle technical deep-dive questions.
maria: Great. I'll update the run-of-show and finalize calendar invite. Thanks everyone! :tada:
aj: Thanks — excited. :rocket:
rehearsal-bot: Rehearsal recording scheduled to start at Wed 2:00 PM PT.
